item.title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth
item.description: Reddit shares plunged 23% after the company warned that Google's AI powered search features were hurting referral traffic and could lead to a decline in daily active users. Pinterest also fell after issuing a weaker revenue outlook, as pressure on European cross border sellers weighed on its business and growth expectations.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: Reddit stock tumbled 30% on Friday after the social media platform warned that Google's growing use of artificial intelligence in search was hurting referral traffic and could weigh on user growth. The warning highlighted how the shift towards AI powered search is disrupting the traditional flow of visitors to websites that have long depended on Google for audience reach, Reuters reported.Reddit stock plunged 29.45% to $91.51, having hit a low of $89.28 earlier in the day.Reddit said its total daily active unique visitors could decline by a low double digit percentage in the fourth quarter from around 130 million if referral traffic continues to weaken. The warning added to pressure on the stock, which had already fallen about 44% this year through Thursday's close.For live updates on US Markets, click hereGoogle's AI search shift puts Reddit traffic at riskThe growing use of AI Overviews and AI Mode in Google Search is changing how users discover information online, potentially reducing the need to visit individual websites for answers.JPMorgan analysts said Google's expansion of AI powered search features, alongside changes to the ranking of machine translated content, had contributed to the decline in search traffic.Also Read: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloffPiper Sandler analysts said a reset in expectations was appropriate, adding that the near term outlook was increasingly clouded.Despite the traffic concerns, Reddit disclosed that it had extended its cloud services agreements with Amazon Web Services and Google through 2029. Under the agreements, the company has committed to spending $880 million and $580 million, respectively, over three years, according to a regulatory filing cited by Reuters.Pinterest also falls on weak revenue outlookReddit was not alone in facing investor concerns. Pinterest shares declined 7.86% to $18.16 after the company issued a weaker than expected fourth quarter revenue forecast, Reuters reported.The image sharing platform reported third quarter revenue of $1.17 billion, missing analysts' estimates of $1.21 billion, according to LSEG data. Its fourth quarter revenue guidance of $1.425 billion to $1.475 billion also fell short of Wall Street expectations.RBC analysts said changes to the European Union's de minimis exemption affected cross border sellers sooner and more severely than expected, leaving Pinterest's European revenue flat.Pinterest shares had fallen about 23% this year through Thursday. If premarket losses held, Reddit stood to lose $5.7 billion in market value, while Pinterest faced a decline of more than $800 million, according to Reuters.

item.title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff
item.description: Intel shares plunged 30% after the chipmaker issued a weak fourth-quarter revenue forecast and warned of negative cash flow for the year. The warning triggered a global semiconductor selloff, with Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks declining as weak PC demand and rising AI infrastructure costs weighed on sentiment.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: Intel shares tumbled 30% on Friday after the chipmaker issued a weaker than expected revenue outlook and warned that it would not generate positive cash flow this year. The warning added to concerns over slowing PC demand and the mounting costs of expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure, triggering a broader selloff across semiconductor stocks, Reuters reported.Intel stock was trading at $64.54, down 29.9%, after having fallen to a low of $64.11 earlier in the day.The weakness extended beyond Intel, with shares of Advanced Micro Devices, Arm Holdings, Qualcomm, Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron falling between 2% and 9% in premarket trading. The selloff also hit companies supplying equipment and infrastructure to the semiconductor industry, reflecting growing investor caution over the AI investment cycle.For live updates on US Markets, click here The market is in a sell first, ask questions later mood right now, and Intel's warning has given investors an easy excuse to take some money off the table across chip stocks, said Matt Britzman, senior equity analyst at Hargreaves Lansdown, according to Reuters.Intel turnaround faces fresh hurdlesIntel's outlook has raised fresh questions about CEO Lip Bu Tan's efforts to revive the chipmaker, which continues to struggle with a prolonged downturn in the personal computer market while spending heavily on manufacturing expansion and AI related opportunities.The company forecast fourth quarter revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion, below analysts' average estimate of $17.07 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Finance chief David Zinsner also said Intel does not expect to generate positive cash flow this year, Reuters reported.Read more: Nasdaq sinks 2.2% as Amazon, Intel fuel fresh fears over AI spendingIntel was on track to lose more than $123 billion in market value.Memory costs add to PC market pressureRising memory prices are creating another challenge for the chipmaker. Suppliers are shifting production capacity towards high bandwidth memory chips used in AI systems, pushing up PC costs and putting further pressure on consumer demand.PC chips contributed roughly half of Intel's third quarter revenue. The company expects sales from the segment to decline more than 20% sequentially in the current quarter, following a 5% drop in the September quarter, Reuters reported. It will be important to see if Intel can expand the highly profitable Xeon product supply to help offset this developing weakness in PC, said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management.He added, Bottom line, weaker sales volumes, higher manufacturing costs, and an out of cycle product mix is a recipe for the stock to decline over the near term as future earnings are under a lot of pressure.
